1: /* particles.js — pool de partículas: faíscas, sangue, fogo, fumaça.
2:  * 🎨 Render: sprites Three (Points) com vida curta, sem alocação por frame.
3:  */
4: import * as THREE from 'three';
5: import { C } from './constants.js';
6: 
7: const MAX = C.PARTICLES.max;
8: 
9: export function createParticles(scene) {
10:   const positions = new Float32Array(MAX * 3);
11:   const colors = new Float32Array(MAX * 3);
12:   const sizes = new Float32Array(MAX);
13:   const geo = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
14:   geo.setAttribute('position', new THREE.BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
15:   geo.setAttribute('color', new THREE.BufferAttribute(colors, 3));
16:   geo.setAttribute('size', new THREE.BufferAttribute(sizes, 1));
17: 
18:   const mat = new THREE.PointsMaterial({
19:     size: 0.12,
20:     vertexColors: true,
21:     transparent: true,
22:     opacity: 0.9,
23:     depthWrite: false,
24:     blending: THREE.AdditiveBlending,
25:   });
26:   const points = new THREE.Points(geo, mat);
27:   points.frustumCulled = false;
28:   scene.add(points);
29: 
30:   const pool = [];
31:   for (let i = 0; i < MAX; i++) {
32:     pool.push({
33:       active: false,
34:       life: 0,
35:       maxLife: 1,
36:       vx: 0, vy: 0, vz: 0,
37:       r: 1, g: 1, b: 1,
38:       size: 0.1,
39:       gravity: 0,
40:     });
41:   }
42: 
43:   let cursor = 0;
44: 
45:   function emit(x, y, z, opts = {}) {
46:     const p = pool[cursor];
47:     cursor = (cursor + 1) % MAX;
48:     p.active = true;
49:     p.life = p.maxLife = opts.life ?? 0.5;
50:     p.vx = opts.vx ?? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
51:     p.vy = opts.vy ?? Math.random() * 2;
52:     p.vz = opts.vz ?? (Math.random() - 0.5) * 2;
53:     p.r = opts.r ?? 1; p.g = opts.g ?? 1; p.b = opts.b ?? 1;
54:     p.size = opts.size ?? 0.1;
55:     p.gravity = opts.gravity ?? 0;
56:     positions[p._i * 3] = x;
57:     positions[p._i * 3 + 1] = y;
58:     positions[p._i * 3 + 2] = z;
59:   }
60: 
61:   pool.forEach((p, i) => { p._i = i; });
62: 
63:   function sparks(x, y, z, n = 6, color = 0xffcc44) {
64:     const c = new THREE.Color(color);
65:     for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
66:       emit(x, y, z, {
67:         life: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.3,
68:         vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
69:         vy: Math.random() * 4,
70:         vz: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 6,
71:         r: c.r, g: c.g, b: c.b,
72:         size: 0.06,
73:         gravity: -6,
74:       });
75:     }
76:   }
77: 
78:   function blood(x, y, z, n = 8) {
79:     for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
80:       emit(x, y, z, {
81:         life: 0.4 + Math.random() * 0.4,
82:         vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3,
83:         vy: Math.random() * 2.5,
84:         vz: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 3,
85:         r: 0.7, g: 0.05, b: 0.05,
86:         size: 0.09,
87:         gravity: -8,
88:       });
89:     }
90:   }
91: 
92:   function fire(x, y, z, n = 10) {
93:     for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
94:       const t = Math.random();
95:       emit(x, y, z, {
96:         life: 0.3 + Math.random() * 0.4,
97:         vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5,
98:         vy: 2 + Math.random() * 2,
99:         vz: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1.5,
100:         r: 1, g: 0.5 + t * 0.4, b: 0.1,
101:         size: 0.15,
102:         gravity: 0,
103:       });
104:     }
105:   }
106: 
107:   function smoke(x, y, z, n = 6) {
108:     for (let i = 0; i < n; i++) {
109:       emit(x, y, z, {
110:         life: 0.8 + Math.random() * 0.6,
111:         vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1,
112:         vy: 1.5 + Math.random() * 1.5,
113:         vz: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 1,
114:         r: 0.4, g: 0.4, b: 0.42,
115:         size: 0.22,
116:         gravity: 0,
117:       });
118:     }
119:   }
120: 
121:   function update(dt) {
122:     for (const p of pool) {
123:       if (!p.active) continue;
124:       p.life -= dt;
125:       if (p.life <= 0) {
126:         p.active = false;
127:         positions[p._i * 3 + 1] = -999;
128:         continue;
129:       }
130:       p.vy += p.gravity * dt;
131:       positions[p._i * 3] += p.vx * dt;
132:       positions[p._i * 3 + 1] += p.vy * dt;
133:       positions[p._i * 3 + 2] += p.vz * dt;
134:       const fade = p.life / p.maxLife;
135:       colors[p._i * 3] = p.r * fade;
136:       colors[p._i * 3 + 1] = p.g * fade;
137:       colors[p._i * 3 + 2] = p.b * fade;
138:       sizes[p._i] = p.size * fade;
139:     }
140:     geo.attributes.position.needsUpdate = true;
141:     geo.attributes.color.needsUpdate = true;
142:     geo.attributes.size.needsUpdate = true;
143:   }
144: 
145:   return { sparks, blood, fire, smoke, update };
146: }
147: 
148: export default createParticles;
